title: staphidiastrum scabridum
intro: Staphidiastrum scabridum, commonly known as the rough-star, is a species of plant in the family Asteraceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Staphidiastrum scabridum include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm their exact effects.
